items.background_format: RGB or RGBA opaque furnished room, no characters/pets/UI/text
items.required_pose: Same approved Home architectural/material language, but keep all5 named launch prop-mount areas empty so movable decorations can be removed without baked duplicates. No public Hub NPCs/stations, baked actors/pets or UI.
layers: Empty furnished background WITHOUT movable slot props
items.parallax: No parallax in the minimum launch set; uniform cover background plus independent props.
items.uniform_cover_scaling: Phone/tablet cover transform preserves aspect; layout meaningful focal content inside central safe region. Never stretch room to aspect.

companion_floor.rule: Clear floor/follower path outside bottom controls; docking anchors in Home placement contract.

display_area.purpose: Existing selectable weapon/scroll/trophy icon; backdrop shelf must not collide with display

items.wardrobe_and_stash: Current Character & Style / Gear-Stash UI buttons access existing systems; room furniture may suggest them but must not bake labels or public Hub NPCs/stations
items.perches: Two separate removable props: universal floor cushion and ledge for Lunarwisp/Breezewyn only. See HOME_COMPANION_INTERACTIONS.json.
items.decorations: Six-item bounded launch catalogue; four accepted assets reused plus two new perch props. See HOME_LAUNCH_DECOR_CATALOGUE.json.

rejection_criteria: Identity drift or use of rejected boards
Missing/doubled/warped anatomy, clipped silhouette, hidden or floating contact
Baked interchangeable equipment, labels, shadows or temporal FX
Wrong canvas/path/sidecar, inferred contact pixels or placeholder/reference card
Native staging, fit or face-target failure; technically valid PNG is not visual acceptance
Baked pets/characters/UI, public Hub NPCs, erased/invented floor copied from obstructed low-resolution board
items.measurement_method: On the final exported canvas with origin top-left, +X right/+Y down, measure palm contact centres (not wrists), Core/eye centre if present, actual supporting anatomy ground boundary, pivot, alpha bounding box, and launch/contact anchors. Ground Y is the boundary below the last occupied supporting pixel. Exclude shadow, lifted feet, FX and speckles. Record final pixel coordinates to 0.01px where available; record uniform source-to-canvas transform and SHA256 after export. Never copy another pose's coordinates.
importer_registration_work_required: Register accepted background and uniform cover route without gameplay changes
Keep character/pet/display/UI separate; introduce layer hook only if separately approved furniture needs occlusion

launch_home_placements.coordinate_space: 480x854 safe-area fitted Home content, origin top-left; +X right/+Y down
protected_areas: Active companion bound at its occupied slot
render_order: Perch front lip only where it occludes lower contact pixels
launch_home_placements.rule: Interactive cushion/ledge/banners/light/display objects must NOT be painted into the furnished background; reserve compatible empty floor/wall mount space. Permanent unrelated room furniture may stay baked. One active pet only.

state_machine.home.companion.perch: Require selected/equipped owned pet, installed allowed perch, all4 new perch views accepted. Use move toward floor anchor; floating pets may move via[374,602]→[374,412]. Grounded pets never jump/teleport onto wall ledge. On docking enter perch_rest.
state_machine.home.companion.greet: Perched pet enters exact perch_interact for0.9seconds then returns perch_rest; trigger only deliberate released tap/button. Suppress additional triggers until completed; no reward/economy effect.
state_machine.home.companion.return: Leave perch using move state toward[110,602], then existing follow idle; do not cross UI areas or fabricate a jumping pose.
state_machine.home.companion.follow: Switch perch mode to follow; preserve owned/equipped ID.
state_machine.missing_state: Disable unavailable interaction with concise preparing-art status; never relabel idle/reaction as perch art.
state_machine.decor_edit: Companion temporarily settles in accepted rest/follow; no gameplay/combat action allowed. Place/remove is draft until Apply.

companion_interaction_contract.runtime_visual_requirements: Existing UI skins/buttons and companion unlock images reused; no new UI sheet/VFX artwork. All interactions cosmetic, original canon unchanged.

mobile_tablet_acceptance.layout_transform: Use existing safe_area_layout.fit_in and physical→logical safe-area conversion. Room interaction/decor slots stay in480x854 fitted scene; separate cover background never sets touch hitboxes.
mobile_tablet_acceptance.gesture_rule: Activate on owned release after tap qualification; drag/scroll cancels tap; no activation on touch-down; consume gesture through release.
mobile_tablet_acceptance.edit_flow: Personal Displays opens Decor mode using existing panel styling. Item row→allowed slot highlight→Place/Remove preview; Apply or Cancel. Simple drag may reposition ghost between allowed slots only, with no commit until Apply. Back cancels pending draft and then returns Home/Hub cleanly.
mobile_tablet_acceptance.no_new_UI_PNG: Reuse current canonical buttons/icons, companion portrait/unlock icons and item thumbnails; no text baked into props.
mobile_tablet_acceptance.hit_test_priority: Modal/editor controls > active pet/perch > noninteractive props. Only occupied active perch hit rect triggers greeting; room background/visual-only props ignore input. No combat attack handlers active in Home.
mobile_tablet_acceptance.tablet_rule: Keep bounded central480x854 scene and same placements, uniform fit; use backdrop for extra space rather than stretching or moving hitboxes relative to art.
